<description>
Currently there is limited continuous testing of our exact release binaries. This is acceptable today as we use many similar toolchain configurations in CI which has most/everything we use in Guix pretty much covered. Many PRs also see Guix builds, although few of those probably run tests against the Guix-built binaries.

This PR would continuously exercise the Guix building process itself, but also, in the event that we start shipping some fully-static Linux builds (x64 and aarch64) as per current revision of #25573, our entire custom-built static glibc and compiler toolchain would be relatively untested by current CI jobs, and that would also be tested here.

----

This adds Guix builds for the following platforms:

- arm64-apple-darwin
- x86_64-linux-gnu
- x86_64-w64-mingw32

The resulting binaries are then tested in a subsequent job.
</description>

<commits>
95e52e18b5 guix: expose time-machine metadata

Make the pinned repository and commit available to callers that source the
Guix prelude.

A Bitcoin Core-specific substitute server only needs to build the
packages in the guix closure at a specific time machine commit. It does
not need to build the bitcoin core binary applications.

To facilitate extracting the time-machine commit, export it as a
variable, so substitute builders (and anybody else) can re-use it by
sourcing the prelude, instead of requiring error-prone command string parsing.

7b753466b6 ci: add Guix build job

Run single-host Guix builds on pull requests and branch pushes. Cache the
prepared Guix image as well as depends sources, built dependencies, and
the macOS SDK so fresh runners can reuse the pinned build environment.

Pass channel metadata from the Guix prelude to the image build. Preserve
its authenticated time-machine profile and store closure, refreshing the
profile timestamp at startup so older cached images remain usable.

Keep container orchestration in one CI script. Copy the read-only checkout
and restored caches into a private build directory, then export outputs
and updated caches as the host user. This avoids changing ownership of the
host checkout. Allow Guix's namespace and personality operations during
image preparation and runtime builds.

df5787913b ci: test Guix codesign environments

The regular Guix builds do not evaluate the codesign manifest, so missing
imports and broken signing dependencies can go unnoticed until signing.

Realize each signing target's environment before its main build to catch
these failures without requiring signatures or signing keys.

04d5a8caef guix: copy config.ini before deleting build dir

This allows us to use the build config.ini in later testing as it's not
deleted.

d9e9d95217 ci: test Guix release binaries

Test x64, windows and macOS binaries on native runners.

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Copyright (c) 2026 The Bitcoin Core developers
+# Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying
+# file COPYING or http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php.
+export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
+set -o errexit -o pipefail
+
+# Guix expires cached time-machine profiles after 30 days. Refresh the image's
+# prepared profile so an older cached image still reuses it.
+touch -h /var/guix/profiles/per-user/root/inferiors/*
+
+guix-daemon --build-users-group=guixbuild &
+daemon_pid=$!
+until guix gc --list-failures > /dev/null; do
+    kill -0 "$daemon_pid" || exit 1
+    sleep 0.1
+done
+guix archive --authorize < /guix-fish-signing-key.pub
+
+exec "$@"

+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Copyright (c) 2026 The Bitcoin Core developers
+# Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying
+# file COPYING or https://opensource.org/license/mit.
+export LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
+set -o errexit -o pipefail
+
+source contrib/guix/libexec/prelude.bash
+
+if [ ! -d .git ]; then
+    echo "This CI runner requires a standalone checkout, not a linked worktree." >&2
+    exit 1
+fi
+
+read -ra cache_args <<< "$DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_ARG"
+docker buildx build "${cache_args[@]}" --allow security.insecure \
+    --file ci/guix_imagefile --tag "$CONTAINER_NAME" \
+    --build-arg guix_version="$GUIX_BINARY_VERSION" \
+    --build-arg guix_time_machine_url="$GUIX_TIME_MACHINE_URL" \
+    --build-arg guix_time_machine_commit="$GUIX_TIME_MACHINE_COMMIT" .
+
+mkdir -p "$SOURCES_PATH" "$BASE_CACHE" "$SDK_PATH"
+container_id="$(docker create --init --privileged --interactive \
+    --mount "type=bind,src=$PWD,dst=/source,readonly" \
+    --mount "type=bind,src=$SOURCES_PATH,dst=/sources-cache,readonly" \
+    --mount "type=bind,src=$BASE_CACHE,dst=/built-cache,readonly" \
+    --mount "type=bind,src=$SDK_PATH,dst=/sdk-cache,readonly" \
+    --env HOSTS --env SUBSTITUTE_URLS \
+    --env SOURCES_PATH=/build/.guix-cache/depends-sources \
+    --env BASE_CACHE=/build/.guix-cache/depends-built \
+    --env SDK_PATH=/build/.guix-cache/sdk \
+    "$CONTAINER_NAME" bash -e)"
+trap 'docker rm --force "$container_id" > /dev/null' EXIT
+
+docker start --attach --interactive "$container_id" <<'EOF'
+mkdir -p /build
+rsync --recursive --links --perms --exclude=/.guix-cache /source/ /build/
+mkdir -p "$SOURCES_PATH" "$BASE_CACHE" "$SDK_PATH"
+cp -R /sources-cache/. "$SOURCES_PATH/"
+cp -R /built-cache/. "$BASE_CACHE/"
+cp -R /sdk-cache/. "$SDK_PATH/"
+cd /build
+git update-index --refresh
+source contrib/guix/libexec/prelude.bash
+
+case "$HOSTS" in
+    arm64-apple-darwin|x86_64-w64-mingw32)
+        export HOST="$HOSTS"
+        JOBS="$(nproc)"
+        time-machine shell --manifest=contrib/guix/manifest_codesign.scm \
+                           --container --pure --no-cwd \
+                           --cores="$JOBS" --keep-failed --fallback \
+                           ${SUBSTITUTE_URLS:+--substitute-urls="$SUBSTITUTE_URLS"} \
+                           -- true
+        ;;
+esac
+
+./contrib/guix/guix-build
+EOF
+
+mkdir -p "$OUTDIR_BASE"
+docker cp "$container_id:/build/guix-build-$VERSION/output/." "$OUTDIR_BASE/"
+docker cp "$container_id:/build/.guix-cache/depends-sources/." "$SOURCES_PATH/"
+docker cp "$container_id:/build/.guix-cache/depends-built/." "$BASE_CACHE/"
+mkdir -p "$(distsrc_for_host "$HOSTS")"
+docker cp "$container_id:/build/guix-build-$VERSION/distsrc-$VERSION-$HOSTS/guix-test-config.ini" \
+    "$(distsrc_for_host "$HOSTS")/guix-test-config.ini"

+# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
+# Copyright (c) 2026 The Bitcoin Core developers
+# Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying
+# file COPYING or http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php.
+
+FROM alpine:3.24
+
+RUN apk --no-cache add \
+    bash \
+    bzip2 \
+    ca-certificates \
+    curl \
+    git \
+    make \
+    rsync \
+    shadow \
+    xz
+
+ARG guix_download_path=https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/guix
+ARG guix_version=1.5.0
+ARG guix_checksum_aarch64=a5d58b1d0294cad6adb1f2aff627d37feb5db763fdffbceb8551f2b12123cf39
+ARG guix_checksum_x86_64=aa41025489c5061543e9c48873eaa829b900b2da75d40f9648913622f5f47817
+ARG builder_count=32
+ARG substitute_server=https://guix.fish.foo
+ARG substitute_server_key_sha256=5796b4e6cc23635052ba7cecdc4b8b92ba6a53ef374208ce5094c0920a72f40f
+
+ENV PATH=/root/.config/guix/current/bin:$PATH
+ENV LC_ALL=C.UTF-8
+
+RUN guix_file_name=guix-binary-${guix_version}.$(uname -m)-linux.tar.xz && \
+    eval "guix_checksum=\${guix_checksum_$(uname -m)}" && \
+    cd /tmp && \
+    curl --fail --location --retry 3 --silent --show-error --output "$guix_file_name" \
+        "${guix_download_path}/${guix_file_name}" && \
+    echo "${guix_checksum}  ${guix_file_name}" | sha256sum -c && \
+    tar xJf "$guix_file_name" && \
+    mv var/guix /var/ && \
+    mv gnu / && \
+    rm "$guix_file_name"
+
+RUN mkdir -p /root/.config/guix && \
+    ln -s /var/guix/profiles/per-user/root/current-guix /root/.config/guix/current && \
+    groupadd --system guixbuild && \
+    for i in $(seq -w 1 ${builder_count}); do \
+        useradd -g guixbuild -G guixbuild \
+            -d /var/empty -s $(which nologin) \
+            -c "Guix build user ${i}" --system "guixbuilder${i}"; \
+    done
+
+RUN curl --fail --location --retry 3 --silent --show-error --output /guix-fish-signing-key.pub \
+        "${substitute_server}/signing-key.pub" && \
+    echo "${substitute_server_key_sha256}  /guix-fish-signing-key.pub" | sha256sum -c
+
+COPY ci/guix-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/guix-entrypoint
+RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/guix-entrypoint
+
+# Keep the pinned Guix, its profile, and channel checkout in the cached image.
+# Guix needs namespaces and personality syscalls while preparing its profile.
+ARG guix_time_machine_url
+ARG guix_time_machine_commit
+RUN --security=insecure guix-daemon --build-users-group=guixbuild & \
+    daemon_pid=$!; \
+    trap 'kill "$daemon_pid"' EXIT; \
+    until guix gc --list-failures > /dev/null; do \
+        kill -0 "$daemon_pid" || exit 1; sleep 0.1; \
+    done; \
+    guix archive --authorize < /guix-fish-signing-key.pub && \
+    guix time-machine --url="$guix_time_machine_url" \
+        --commit="${guix_time_machine_commit:?}" \
+        --substitute-urls="https://guix.fish.foo https://guix2.fish.foo" \
+        -- --version
+
+ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/guix-entrypoint"]
+CMD ["bash"]

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Copyright (c) 2026-present The Bitcoin Core developers
+# Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying
+# file COPYING or https://opensource.org/license/mit/.
+
+"""Run tests against an extracted Guix release package."""
+
+import configparser
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+
+def main():
+    workspace = Path.cwd()
+    packages = list((workspace / "guix-test-package").glob("bitcoin-*.tar.gz"))
+    packages += list((workspace / "guix-test-package").glob("bitcoin-*.zip"))
+    if len(packages) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected one Guix package, found {packages}")
+
+    extracted = workspace / "guix-test-package" / "extracted"
+    shutil.unpack_archive(str(packages[0]), extracted)
+    roots = list(extracted.glob("bitcoin-*"))
+    if len(roots) != 1:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected one package directory, found {roots}")
+    package = roots[0]
+    extension = ".exe" if sys.platform == "win32" else ""
+
+    if sys.platform == "darwin":
+        # Apple Silicon requires signatures. Sign the extracted copy only.
+        for directory in (package / "bin", package / "libexec"):
+            for binary in directory.iterdir():
+                if binary.is_file() and os.access(binary, os.X_OK):
+                    if subprocess.run(["codesign", "--verify", str(binary)], capture_output=True).returncode != 0:
+                        subprocess.run(["codesign", "--sign", "-", str(binary)], check=True)
+
+    config = configparser.ConfigParser()
+    with (workspace / "guix-test-package" / "config.ini").open(encoding="utf-8") as file:
+        config.read_file(file)
+    config["environment"]["SRCDIR"] = str(workspace)
+    config["environment"]["BUILDDIR"] = str(workspace)
+    config["environment"]["RPCAUTH"] = str(workspace / "share" / "rpcauth" / "rpcauth.py")
+    with (workspace / "test" / "config.ini").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as file:
+        config.write(file)
+
+    sanitizer_template = (workspace / "test" / "with_sanitizer_env.py.in").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    (workspace / "test" / "with_sanitizer_env.py").write_text(
+        sanitizer_template.replace("@PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR@", workspace.as_posix()), encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+
+    env = os.environ.copy()
+    binaries = {
+        "BITCOIN_BIN": "bitcoin",
+        "BITCOIND": "bitcoind",
+        "BITCOINCLI": "bitcoin-cli",
+        "BITCOINUTIL": "bitcoin-util",
+        "BITCOINTX": "bitcoin-tx",
+        "BITCOINWALLET": "bitcoin-wallet",
+    }
+    for variable, name in binaries.items():
+        env[variable] = str(package / "bin" / f"{name}{extension}")
+    env["PATH"] = os.pathsep.join([str(package / "bin"), env["PATH"]])
+
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(workspace / "test"))
+    from download_utils import download_script_assets
+
+    unit_data = workspace / "unit_test_data"
+    download_script_assets(unit_data)
+    env["DIR_UNIT_TEST_DATA"] = str(unit_data)
+    subprocess.run([str(package / "libexec" / f"test_bitcoin{extension}"), "-l", "test_suite"], env=env, check=True)
+
+    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(workspace / "test" / "get_previous_releases.py")], check=True)
+    functional_command = [
+        sys.executable,
+        str(workspace / "test" / "functional" / "test_runner.py"),
+        f"--jobs={os.cpu_count() or 1}",
+        "--quiet",
+        "--failfast",
+        "--timeout-factor=40" if sys.platform == "win32" else "--timeout-factor=1",
+    ]
+    if sys.platform == "win32":
+        # Old releases cannot read the Unicode test runner directory on Windows.
+        for name in ("feature_unsupported_utxo_db", "wallet_ancient_migration"):
+            functional_command += ["--exclude", name]
+    subprocess.run(functional_command, env=env, check=True)
+
+    if sys.platform == "win32":
+        for name in ("feature_unsupported_utxo_db", "wallet_ancient_migration"):
+            subprocess.run([
+                sys.executable,
+                str(workspace / "test" / "functional" / f"{name}.py"),
+                "--previous-releases",
+                f"--tmpdir={workspace / f'test_{name}'}",
+            ], env=env, check=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Copyright (c) 2023-present The Bitcoin Core developers
+# Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying
+# file COPYING or https://opensource.org/license/mit.
+
+---
+name: Guix
+on:
+  # See: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#pull_request.
+  pull_request:
+  # See: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/writing-workflows/choosing-when-your-workflow-runs/events-that-trigger-workflows#push.
+  push:
+    branches:
+      - '**'
+    tags-ignore:
+      - '**'
+
+concurrency:
+  group: guix-${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' && github.run_id || github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+env:
+  GUIX_BINARY_VERSION: 1.5.0
+  CONTAINER_NAME: guix-ci
+  SOURCES_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/.guix-cache/depends-sources
+  BASE_CACHE: ${{ github.workspace }}/.guix-cache/depends-built
+  SDK_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/.guix-cache/sdk
+  SUBSTITUTE_URLS: https://guix.fish.foo https://guix2.fish.foo
+
+defaults:
+  run:
+    shell: bash
+
+jobs:
+  guix:
+    name: Guix, ${{ matrix.host }}
+    if: ${{ vars.SKIP_BRANCH_PUSH != 'true' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
+    runs-on: ${{ github.repository == 'bitcoin/bitcoin' && 'warp-ubuntu-latest-x64-8x' || 'ubuntu-24.04' }}
+    timeout-minutes: 360
+    strategy:
+      matrix:
+        host:
+          - arm64-apple-darwin
+          - x86_64-linux-gnu
+          - x86_64-w64-mingw32
+    env:
+      HOSTS: ${{ matrix.host }}
+
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+
+      - name: Configure Docker
+        uses: ./.github/actions/configure-docker
+        with:
+          provider: ${{ github.repository == 'bitcoin/bitcoin' && 'warp' || 'gha' }}
+
+      - name: Restore depends sources cache
+        id: depends-sources-cache
+        uses: ./.github/actions/cache/restore/internal
+        with:
+          provider: ${{ github.repository == 'bitcoin/bitcoin' && 'warp' || 'gha' }}
+          path: ${{ env.SOURCES_PATH }}
+          key: guix-depends-sources-${{ matrix.host }}-${{ hashFiles('depends/**') }}
+          restore-keys: guix-depends-sources-${{ matrix.host }}-
+
+      - name: Restore built depends cache
+        id: built-depends-cache
+        uses: ./.github/actions/cache/restore/internal
+        with:
+          provider: ${{ github.repository == 'bitcoin/bitcoin' && 'warp' || 'gha' }}
+          path: ${{ env.BASE_CACHE }}
+          key: guix-built-depends-${{ matrix.host }}-${{ env.GUIX_BINARY_VERSION }}-${{ hashFiles('depends/**') }}-${{ hashFiles('contrib/guix/**') }}
+          restore-keys: guix-built-depends-${{ matrix.host }}-${{ env.GUIX_BINARY_VERSION }}-
+
+      - name: Restore macOS SDK cache
+        if: matrix.host == 'arm64-apple-darwin'
+        id: macos-sdk-cache
+        uses: ./.github/actions/cache/restore/internal
+        with:
+          provider: ${{ github.repository == 'bitcoin/bitcoin' && 'warp' || 'gha' }}
+          path: ${{ env.SDK_PATH }}
+          key: guix-macos-sdk-${{ hashFiles('depends/hosts/darwin.mk', 'ci/test/00_setup_env_mac_cross.sh') }}
+          restore-keys: guix-macos-sdk-
+
+      - name: Install macOS SDK
+        if: matrix.host == 'arm64-apple-darwin'
+        run: |
+          source ci/test/00_setup_env_mac_cross.sh
+          sdk_name="Xcode-$XCODE_VERSION-$XCODE_BUILD_ID-extracted-SDK-with-libcxx-headers"
+          sdk_path="$SDK_PATH/$sdk_name"
+          sdk_archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/$sdk_name.tar"
+          if [ ! -d "$sdk_path" ]; then
+            mkdir -p "$SDK_PATH"
+            curl --location --fail "$SDK_URL/$sdk_name.tar" --output "$sdk_archive"
+            printf '%s  %s\n' "$OSX_SDK_SHA256" "$sdk_archive" | sha256sum --check
+            tar -C "$SDK_PATH" -xf "$sdk_archive"
+          fi
+
+      - name: CI script
+        run: ./ci/guix_run_all.sh
+
+      - name: Prepare test package

+              ;;
+            x86_64-linux-gnu)

+              ;;
+            x86_64-w64-mingw32)
+              package="$(outdir_for_host '${{ matrix.host }}')/${DISTNAME}-win64-unsigned.zip"

+

+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7

+
+      - name: Save depends sources cache

+        uses: ./.github/actions/cache/save/internal

+          path: ${{ env.SOURCES_PATH }}

+
+      - name: Save macOS SDK cache

+        uses: ./.github/actions/cache/save/internal
+        with:
+          provider: ${{ github.repository == 'bitcoin/bitcoin' && 'warp' || 'gha' }}
+          path: ${{ env.SDK_PATH }}
+          key: ${{ steps.macos-sdk-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
+
+      - name: Save built depends cache
+        if: success() && github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_name == github.event.repository.default_branch && steps.built-depends-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
+        uses: ./.github/actions/cache/save/internal
+        with:
+          provider: ${{ github.repository == 'bitcoin/bitcoin' && 'warp' || 'gha' }}
+          path: ${{ env.BASE_CACHE }}
+          key: ${{ steps.built-depends-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
+
+  test:
+    name: Test Guix, ${{ matrix.host }}
+    needs: guix
+    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
+    timeout-minutes: 180
+    env:
+      CI_FAILFAST_TEST_LEAVE_DANGLING: 1
+      PYTHONUTF8: 1
+    strategy:

+      matrix:

+          - host: arm64-apple-darwin
+            runner: macos-15
+          - host: x86_64-linux-gnu
+            runner: ubuntu-24.04
+          - host: x86_64-w64-mingw32

+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout
+        uses: actions/checkout@v6
+

+          path: guix-test-package
+
+      - name: Restore previous releases cache

+        uses: ./.github/actions/cache/restore/internal

+      - name: Save previous releases cache
